paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of Qwen2 under different question popularity.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The chart illustrates the relationship between question popularity and three performance metrics—Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment—for the Qwen2-7B model on a basketball-themed dataset. 
The X-axis is labeled "Question Popularity," has a linear scale, and ranges from 5.0 to 25.0, with evenly spaced numerical labels at intervals of 2.5. 
The Y-axis is labeled "Values," also has a linear scale, and spans from 0.0 to 1.0, with numerical labels at intervals of 0.2. 
The chart contains three distinct lines, each representing one of the metrics. 
The blue line, representing Accuracy, is marked with circles and remains mostly stable with a slight increase from approximately 0.1 to 0.12 between 5.0 and 10.0 on the X-axis, after which it plateaus. 
The green line, representing Confidence, is marked with triangles and starts at about 0.72 at 5.0 on the X-axis, dips slightly to around 0.7 before rising steadily to approximately 0.85 at 25.0. 
The red line, representing Alignment, is marked with squares and begins at roughly 0.37 at 5.0, remains relatively constant until around 10.0, and then gradually decreases to about 0.26 at 25.0.
model_annotations.German: The diagram illustrates the performance of the Qwen2-7B model on a basketball dataset, specifically its accuracy, confidence, and alignment in relation to question popularity. The x-axis represents question popularity, ranging from 5.0 to 25.0 in increments of 2.5, while the y-axis represents values between 0.0 and 1.0 in increments of 0.2. The diagram includes three lines: a blue line with circle markers representing accuracy, a green line with triangle markers representing confidence, and a red line with square markers representing alignment. The accuracy line remains relatively stable, starting at approximately 0.1 at a question popularity of 5.0 and ending at around 0.12 at a question popularity of 25.0, with a slight increase between 5.0 and 7.5. The confidence line begins at around 0.72 at a question popularity of 5.0 and increases to approximately 0.84 at a question popularity of 25.0, displaying a generally upward trend. The alignment line starts at around 0.37 at a question popularity of 5.0 and decreases to approximately 0.27 at a question popularity of 25.0, showing a downward trend.
